claims.detail: Prescribes each next session's sets, reps and weights from logged history
claims.quote: Gravl estimates your one-rep max from your logged history and prescribes the next session from it.

claims.detail: Adds reps set by set until the target is met, then raises the weight one step
claims.quote: Reps climb set by set; when the ladder fills, the weight steps up, snapped to the plates or stack you actually have.

claims.detail: Recommended loads are rounded to plates, dumbbells or stack increments the gym actually has
claims.quote: Every weight gets snapped to something your gym can actually load: dumbbell steps, the plates you own, or the exact increments of a machine's stack

claims.detail: Rate effort after an exercise; the rating steers the next prescription
claims.quote: Rate a set Easy or Hard and the next prescription adjusts.

claims.detail: Log sets and reps, run rest timers and finish a session from the watch
claims.quote: A standalone Apple Watch app. Log sets and reps, run rest timers, and finish a whole session from the watch.

claims.detail: Single score comparing lifts against bodyweight- and sex-based standards, tracked over time per muscle group
claims.quote: See how your lifts compare against standards for your body weight and sex, tracked over time across every muscle group.

claims.detail: Generated workouts only use exercises possible with the equipment in the gym profile
claims.quote: Gravl accounts for the equipment you own, which muscles are still recovering, what you trained last session, and which lifts you've neglected.

claims.detail: 300+ trainer-led exercise demonstration videos
claims.quote: 300+ trainer-led exercise videos, downloadable for offline use.

claims.detail: Download exercise videos by category to play without a connection
claims.quote: Toggle the exercise categories you want - Weights, Bodyweight, Cardio, Stretching and so on. Each one shows how many videos it has and how much space it needs, so no surprises.

claims.detail: Written instructions alongside each exercise video
claims.quote: Watch the Video and instructions.

claims.detail: Generates a full personalized workout plan from goals, equipment and schedule
claims.quote: Gravl is an AI-powered training platform that uses a scientific algorithm and your onboarding information to build your personalized training plan.

claims.detail: Plans the whole training week, recalculated after every logged workout
claims.quote: While your coach is still typing, Gravl has your week built: every set, every rep, every kilo, progressive overload included, recalculated after every workout you log.

claims.detail: Split that picks each session's muscles from recovery state and recent history
claims.quote: The system dynamically adjusts training days and muscle groups based on your recovery status and weekly training history.

claims.detail: Library of ready-made splits (full body, PPL, upper/lower, bro split, etc.)
claims.quote: You can choose from a selection of scientifically-backed routines tailored to various goals and experience levels.

claims.detail: Build your own split from saved workouts or chosen muscle groups, 1-7 workouts
claims.quote: On the menu sheet, tap Custom Split to build one from scratch, or AI Import to pull workouts in from a link, PDF, or photo.

claims.detail: Recommends a training plan from schedule, goals and equipment
claims.quote: Personalized plan recommendations: Get help choosing a training plan based on your schedule, goals, and available equipment.

claims.detail: Structured multi-phase plans from named coaches with previews and their own exercise videos
claims.quote: Creator training plans: Train with Hermes and Sandra through structured plans with progressive phases, workout previews, and exercise videos.

claims.feature: AI import of workouts and programs
claims.detail: Turn a social post, whiteboard photo, PDF or link into trackable workouts/splits
claims.quote: Got a routine on Instagram or TikTok, a photo of a whiteboard, or a PDF from your coach? Drop it into Gravl and AI turns it into a real workout: every set, rep and weight ready to track in your next session.

claims.detail: Generate a single session from chosen muscles, duration, variety and goal
claims.quote: Once you've made up all your choices, tap Create session and watch our AI create your workout obeying all your wishes.

claims.detail: Rebuild today's session with the same muscles but different exercises
claims.quote: Regenerate keeps the same muscles and builds the session again with different exercises.

claims.detail: Skip to the next workout in the plan, or jump ahead to a later one
claims.quote: Skip moves you on to the following workout in your plan.

claims.feature: Start any workout of the week
claims.detail: Start any of the week's planned workouts and change their order
claims.quote: Start any workout for the week and easily change the order.

claims.detail: Shows the rest of the week's planned sessions in a carousel
claims.quote: With it on, the rest of your week shows up in the "This Week" carousel on the Train tab.

claims.detail: Change the length of just the next session (30-90 min) and rebuild it
claims.quote: The slider runs from 30 to 90 minutes in steps of 5, and the new length is applied when you close the sheet, not on a confirm button.

claims.detail: Default session length 30-90 minutes used to size generated workouts
claims.quote: How much time would you like to dedicate to your workout sessions? Select between 30 and 90 minutes.

claims.detail: Four goals (build muscle, general fitness, conditioning, get stronger) that change rep ranges and exercise choice
claims.quote: Select from four options designed to meet your needs and reach your fitness goals.

claims.detail: Choose 1-7 training days per week
claims.quote: Choose the number of days you want to work out each week, ranging from 1 to 7.

claims.detail: No experience / beginner / intermediate / advanced shapes starting plan and weights
claims.quote: Making the right selection will help us tailor the perfect plan for you. Pick the one that best describes your situation.

claims.detail: Consistent, balanced or varied exercise rotation
claims.quote: Tap the sliders icon at the top right of the Train tab to open Workout Settings, then under Training Style select Variety Level and choose between:

claims.detail: Min and max set counts for compound and isolation exercises
claims.quote: Customize your workouts by selecting the desired minimum and maximum number of sets for both compound and isolation exercises.

claims.detail: Rep ranges from 3-5 up to 15+ per compound/isolation
claims.quote: Choose ranges from 3-5 up to 15+ reps for compound exercises, and from 5-8 up to 15+ for isolation exercises

claims.detail: Same weight each set with reps adjusted
claims.quote: Straight - same weight in each set, with reps adjusted

claims.detail: Weight increases while reps decrease across sets
claims.quote: Pyramid - increase weight while decreasing reps in each set

claims.detail: Reps increase while weight decreases across sets
claims.quote: Reverse pyramid - increase reps while decreasing weight in each set

claims.detail: Schedule deload windows with start/end date and intensity percentage; excluded from progression
claims.quote: Select the Start and End Date and the Intensity.

claims.detail: Prioritize up to two muscle groups placed first in workouts
claims.quote: You can select up to two muscle groups to focus on.

claims.detail: Exclude up to four muscle groups from workouts
claims.quote: you can select up to 4 muscle groups that will be completely excluded from your workouts.

claims.detail: Mark exercises as don't-recommend so the generator avoids them
claims.quote: You can choose which exercises to exclude and our AI will find alternatives while creating your workouts.

claims.detail: Mark exercises to be recommended more often
claims.quote: Once you've found the exercise, tap the three dots and select "Recommend more often".

claims.detail: Queue specific exercises to appear in upcoming generated workouts
claims.quote: We created the queue feature so that you can ensure certain exercises are included in your next workout.

claims.detail: Log painful movements by body area; generated workouts avoid or substitute those movement patterns
claims.quote: You tell Gravl which movements hurt, and it will avoid exercises associated with those movement patterns until you report that they feel fine again.

claims.detail: Every two weeks asks whether flagged movements still hurt and clears them
claims.quote: Every two weeks, Gravl checks in about each movement you flagged:

claims.detail: Swap any exercise for a same-muscle alternative with sets/reps/weights recalculated
claims.quote: Machine taken? Swap any exercise in one tap. Gravl finds a same-muscle match and recalculates sets, reps and weights instantly.

claims.detail: Tap a target weight to see why it was chosen (last session, rating, position, carry-over)
claims.quote:
Tap any target weight and Gravl tells you why it picked it, based on
your estimated 1RM and how the lift has gone recently.

claims.detail: Every logged set is converted into an estimated one-rep max
claims.quote: Reading: every set you log gets converted into an estimated 1RM.

claims.detail: Set or edit an exercise's 1RM in its advanced settings
claims.quote: Set your next 1RM

claims.detail: Lower every recommended weight and 1RM by a chosen percentage (up to 60%) after a break
claims.quote: Move the slider to choose how much to take off, up to 60%, and every recommended weight and 1RM drops by that amount.

claims.detail: Recommended weight accounts for an exercise's position in the workout
claims.quote: We adjust the weights based on the exercise order because your lifting capabilities vary depending on whether an exercise is performed first or last within a muscle group.

claims.detail: Strength gained on variant or same-muscle exercises carries over to an exercise you return to
claims.quote: Variant exercises transfer at about 90%.

claims.detail: Eases suggested weights slightly after more than two weeks without training a muscle
claims.quote: If a muscle goes untrained for more than two weeks, Gravl eases the suggestions down by roughly 1% per week, and never by more than a few percent in total.

claims.detail: When to add weight is learned per user and per lift from prior increases
claims.quote: The thresholds that decide when you get 2.5 kg more are per user and per lift, learned from what happened after every previous bump.

claims.detail: Exertion rating and progressive overload (rep ladder) for bodyweight exercises
claims.quote: Added exertion rate and progressive overload for bodyweight exercises.

claims.detail: Explain-with-AI plain summary of the week's Strength Score changes
claims.quote: Short on time? Tap Explain with AI for a quick, plain summary of your week.

claims.detail: AI-written summary of each completed workout
claims.quote: Added workout AI summaries for completed workouts.

claims.detail: Record or upload a set video and get a 1-100 score with form, tempo and range sub-scores and fixes
claims.quote: Record a set, get a score from 1 to 100 and find out exactly what to fix - like having a coach watch every rep!

claims.feature: Form score history and friend leaderboard

claims.detail: Message real coaches in-app for app tips or workout advice
claims.quote: Get support from our coaches anytime. Whether it’s app tips or workout advice, just message us in-app.

claims.detail: Support assistant in the app with photo attachments and hand-off to a person
claims.quote:
Support is in the app now. Ask the assistant, attach a photo, or talk to

claims.detail: Configurable 0-4 warm-up sets for compound and isolation exercises

claims.detail: Post-workout stretches targeting trained muscles

claims.detail: Shows plates per side for barbell and plate-loaded exercises

notes: Excluded as beta: Voice and Text workout creation ('both in Beta', help create-a-one-time-custom-workout). Excluded: Gravl Macros (separate app, food/camera calorie tracking) and its bundle/free-month offers; pricing, Lifetime plan, Uala promo. Circuits: the 2026-07-28 vs-Fitbod blog says Gravl has no circuits, but the help article (updated 2026-09-27) documents 'Add to circuit' for a 3rd exercise in a superset; kept as a claim from the newer help source. App Store description calls the Apple Watch app 'standalone', but the help centre says the phone must be within reach and owns/saves the session; Garmin and Wear OS apps are explicitly companions. Languages: App Store lists 8 (EN, CS, FR, DE, IT, PL, PT, ES); the vs-Fitbod blog claims 9. iPad: product page compatibility lists only iPhone, Apple Vision and Apple Watch (no iPad-specific claim). Vision Pro claim is only the store compatibility line. Developer API is labelled 'Beta - the surface is stable' and read-only; MCP has write actions. Kept both since they are publicly available, but flag if beta exclusion should apply. 'Reps Progression' was renamed 'Rep style' (1.53.3) - not a removal. Rest-timer-sound claim rests on a bug-fix note that references the sound. Release-notes coverage only 2026-03-01..2026-10-05 per the collected file. Live Globe (gravl.ai/globe) is a public website map of live workouts, not recorded as an app feature. Gravl Academy/Fitness help articles are educational content, not recorded as a feature.
